definition-changed.answer: The rule's input/output procedure is the procedure-name-1 [THRU procedure-name-2] range of SORT/MERGE in both editions; §2002:4 (entry 4.150) ('one or more successive paragraphs or sections') names the same range that §2023:3.145 does. Scope unchanged. The return mechanism is inserted after the last statement of that range in both.
